entities.summary: Vladislav Anatolevich Kolyachonok is a Belarusian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Texas Stars in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Dallas Stars of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Florida Panthers, 52nd overall, in the 2019 NHL entry draft. He previously played for Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League, and made his NHL debut in 2022 with the Arizona Coyotes. He also previously played for their successors, the Utah Hockey Club, as well as the Pittsburgh Penguins and Boston Bruins.
